description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. No 11 of 2021 " KPMG PROFESSIONAL SERVICES (PRIVATE) LTD  "
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It contains an official order specifying regulatory designations, exemptions, and incentives for a business entity, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe, it does not focus on his appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory action being taken under statutory authority. The content centers on legal frameworks, regulatory compliance, and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
